title: 第六百一十七章 实力飙升剧终第六百一十六章 柏嘉神王VS弩雅大长老
lines: 凯撒亲王速来冷静的脸上乍然变色，在场的其他星空巨人也没好到哪里去，几乎是齐刷刷变了脸色。
这可太让人意外了~
哪怕淡定如吴辉，这会儿都忍不住讶异地扬了扬眉毛。
神域藏得可够深的，就连已经成功混进去的蓝芙迪他们事先竟然都没得到半点消息。
估计这位“菲尔斯神王”晋升神王也就是最近的事情，要不然，不可能瞒得这么严实。
如果这就是神域为这次埋伏行动准备的后手的话，那这后手，说实话还挺成功的。
“我来拦住他！你们快走！”
凯撒亲王猛地反应过来，二话不说便朝着菲尔斯神王冲了过去。
“哼~不知死活。”
见状，菲尔斯神王不屑地轻笑了一声，随手便抽出腰间的长剑，一剑朝凯撒亲王刺去。
剑意横空，如同骄阳烈日，能销金融血。
十五级的强者，哪怕只是随手一击，也有着无可匹敌的强大威势。
凯撒亲王使出全力才勉强抗住了这一剑，脸色却瞬间涨得血红，血脉震荡之下直接就是一口血喷了出来。
然而，他却没有后退，仍是迎着菲尔斯神王冲了过去。
他心里清楚，凭自己的实力，根本扛不住十五级神王几下，但眼前的情况，他别无选择。
他可以不顾惜自己的生死，只要女王陛下能安全离开这里就行！
“凯撒叔叔！”
见到这一幕，伊尔古丽的眼眶瞬间红了。
“陛下，冷静一点。”吴辉凑到她身边，沉声询问，“往哪边突围？”
伊尔古丽抹了把差点溢出眼眶的泪花。
她的声音不知什么时候已经哑了，说出的话却斩钉截铁，没有丝毫犹豫：“继续。往守钥星方向突围！”
吴辉诧异地看了她一眼。
他不是惊讶于她能推断出目前唯一的生路，而是惊讶于她的果决和毫不犹豫。
一个刚刚成年的巨人少女，能有这样的决断力，当真是不容易了。
伊尔古丽却已经没空说别的，二话不说就提起武器冲了出去。
开弓没有回头箭。
事已至此，已经容不得她临场退缩。
守钥星周围还有一层用秘法设下的防御禁制，是当初刚刚发现星河之钥时弩雅大长老设下的。
有这层禁制在，好歹能拖延一会时间。
趁这段时间，她可以试着催熟星河之钥。而只要星河之钥成功催熟，就还有机会。
莫琳·笛卡尔，皮特夫人，迪伦夫人三位王廷女官什么也没问，抄起武器便冲到了最前方，代替凯撒亲王开始给伊尔古丽开路。
一行人缓慢，却坚定地继续开始突围。
然而，凯撒亲王跟菲尔斯神王之间足足差了一阶的实力，即便已经竭尽全力，依旧没能拦住多久。
不过短短一刻钟之后，已经彻底失去战斗力的凯撒亲王就被丢到了一行人面前。
看那状态，虽然还没死，但距离死亡也已经不远了。
菲尔斯神王没直接杀了他，而是吊着那一口气，只怕未必是安了好心，而是戏耍的心态居多。
伊尔古丽身形一顿，狠狠看向了姿态悠闲的菲尔斯神王。
哪怕到了这时候，她澄澈的金眸中也没有丝毫惧色，有的只是深切的恨意。
星空巨人之中或许难免还是会有些怯战怕死的胆小鬼，但这些人里，绝对不会包括她。她是星空主君的后裔，身体里流淌的是英雄的血，宁可站着死，也不会跪着生。
“呵呵~眼神不错。”菲尔斯神王态度恶劣地笑了一声，目光在伊尔古丽青春俏丽的脸上逡巡一圈，随即遗憾地摇了摇头，“长得也不错，可惜是个巨人~”
说罢，他便再次举起了手中的长剑，朝着伊尔古丽刺去。
今天，他的主要任务就杀死这位天资卓绝的年轻巨人王。
他绝不会允许，星空巨人一族出现第二位十五级强者。
content_en:
…
Prince Caesar's calm and calm face suddenly changed color, and the other star giants present were not much better, almost all of them changed their expressions.
This is so surprising~
Even as calm as Wu Hui, he couldn't help but raise his eyebrows in surprise at this moment.
The Divine Realm is so well hidden that even Lan Fudi and the others, who had successfully sneaked in, didn't even get any information beforehand.
It is estimated that this "God King of Phils" was promoted to God King recently. Otherwise, it would be impossible to hide it so tightly.
If this was the back-up plan prepared by God's Domain for this ambush operation, then this back-up plan was quite successful to be honest.
"I'm going to stop him! You go!"
Prince Caesar reacted suddenly and rushed towards God King Phils without saying a word.
"Hmph~ I don't know whether to live or die."
Upon seeing this, God King Phils chuckled disdainfully, casually drew out the long sword from his waist, and stabbed Prince Caesar with one sword.
The sword's will spreads across the sky, like the scorching sun, capable of burning financial blood.
A level 15 expert, even with just a casual strike, has unrivaled power.
Prince Caesar used all his strength to barely resist the sword, but his face instantly turned blood red, and a mouthful of blood spurted out due to the shock in his blood vessels.
However, he did not retreat, and still rushed towards King Phils.
He knew in his heart that with his own strength, he couldn't withstand a few blows from the fifteenth-level God King, but in the situation before him, he had no choice.
He doesn't care about his life or death, as long as Her Majesty the Queen can leave here safely!
"Uncle Caesar!"
Seeing this scene, Ilguli's eyes instantly turned red.
"Your Majesty, calm down." Wu Hui approached her and asked in a deep voice, "Which way should we break out?"
Ilgul wiped away the tears that almost overflowed from her eyes.
Her voice had become mute at some point, but her words were decisive, without any hesitation: "Continue. Break out in the direction of the Key Star!"
Wu Hui glanced at her in surprise.
He was not surprised that she could deduce the only way to survive at present, but he was surprised by her determination and hesitation.
It is really not easy for a giant girl who has just grown up to have such decisiveness.
"Let's go!!"
However, Ilgul had no time to say anything else, so she picked up the weapon and rushed out without saying a word.
There is no turning back when the bow is drawn.
The matter has reached this point, and there is no room for her to back down on the spot.
There is also a layer of defensive restrictions set up with secret methods around the Key Keeper Star. It was set up by Elder Nuya when the Key to the Galaxy was first discovered.
With this level of restriction, it can delay the process for a while.
During this time, she could try to ripen the Key to the Galaxy. And as long as the Key to the Galaxy is successfully ripened, there will still be a chance.
Maureen Descartes, Mrs. Pitt, and Mrs. Dylan didn't ask any questions. They picked up their weapons and rushed to the front, replacing Prince Caesar and starting to clear the way for Ilgul.
The group of people slowly but surely continued to break out.
However, there was a huge gap in strength between Prince Caesar and God King Phils. Even though they tried their best, they still could not stop him for long.
However, just a quarter of an hour later, Prince Caesar, who had completely lost his fighting ability, was thrown in front of the group of people.
Looking at that state, although he is not dead yet, he is not far away from death.
God King Phils did not kill him directly, but held his breath, fearing that it may not be because of his good intentions, but mostly because of his playful mentality.
Ilguli paused and looked fiercely at the leisurely posture of God King Phils.
Even now, there was no fear in her clear golden eyes, only deep hatred.
There may still be some cowards among the star giants who are afraid of fighting and death, but she will definitely not be included among these people. She is a descendant of the Lord of the Starry Sky, and her body is filled with the blood of heroes. She would rather die standing than live on her knees.
"Haha~ You have nice eyes." God King Phils laughed with a bad attitude, his eyes wandered around Ilguli's young and pretty face, and then he shook his head regretfully, "He looks good, but he is a giant~"
After saying that, he raised the sword in his hand again and stabbed towards Ilgul.
Today, his main task is to kill this talented young giant king.
He would never allow a second fifteenth-level powerhouse to appear in the starry sky giant clan.
